description: 8 digital input and 8 digital output module for the ioThinx 4510 adapter
source: Moxa, ioThinx 4510 Series User's Manual, version 6.2 (July 2024), Appendix A (Modbus/TCP slave rules and register lists)
notes: Addresses are relative to the module: the Modbus address on the 4510 is the slot's base address (set on the Modbus page of the 4510 web console: reload the default addresses or edit them) plus the relative address given here, separately for coils, discrete inputs, holding registers and input registers. Modbus/TCP port 502 on the ioThinx 4510 adapter.

The manual lists every parameter with a length: in bits for coils and discrete inputs, and in 16-bit registers for the others. A DWORD or REAL value takes two registers; a REAL is a 32-bit float. Per-channel entries here follow that: for example 8 registers of DWORD for 4 channels are four 32-bit values.

The manual does not state the word order of the 32-bit values; big is assumed. The function codes are 1, 5 and 15 for coils, 2 for discrete inputs, 3, 6 and 16 for holding registers and 4 for input registers.
Each 'All' register is a bit mask with one bit per channel.
The earlier version of this map read the counters as 64-bit values; the manual and its RESTful API list them as 32-bit (0 to 4294967295).
